title: Iberia/St. Mary Upland Levee (TV-0102)
intro: A three-stop look at this CPRA project: where it is, what it changes, and its status and funding.

steps.title: Where it's at
steps.body: This project spans Iberia and St. Mary Parishes, between the Delcambre Canal and the Charenton Canal.

media.alt: Aerial view of the corridor between the Delcambre and Charenton Canals, Iberia/St. Mary Parishes (2024 aerial imagery).

steps.title: What it is changing
steps.body: Low-lying communities along this corridor face growing risk from storm surge and tidal flooding with no engineered barrier to stop it. This large-scale project is designing an earthen levee system — with T-walls, barge gates, and pump stations — to protect roughly 140,000 acres and reduce flood damage for homes and businesses in both parishes.

steps.title: Timeline / Completion Date
steps.body: Project Status: In Engineering & Design. Estimated Cost: $15,000,000. Funding Source: Gulf of Mexico Energy Security Act (GOMESA).
